# Exec-Air Air Conditioning

> South African HVAC specialists. Founded 1989. Based at 296 Voortrekker Road, Krugersdorp, Gauteng. Serving commercial, industrial and residential clients across Krugersdorp, Johannesburg, the West Rand, greater Gauteng and Southern Africa.

## Company Facts

- Legal name: Exec-Air Air Conditioning (Pty) Ltd
- Trading name: Exec-Air
- Founded: 1989 (over 35 years of experience)
- Head office: 296 Voortrekker Road, Krugersdorp, Gauteng 1739, South Africa
- Phone: +27 11 477 3920
- WhatsApp: +27 82 619 0881
- Email: info@execair.co.za
- B-BBEE: Proudly Level 3 Contributor (2023 verification)
- Service area: Krugersdorp, Johannesburg, West Rand, Gauteng, Southern Africa
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 07:30 – 17:00 SAST

## Services

- Design, build and installation of HVAC systems
- Commercial, industrial and residential air-conditioning
- Heating, ventilation and indoor air-quality solutions
- Ductwork, ventilation and extraction systems
- Evaporative cooling and air-curtain systems
- HVAC maintenance and repair contracts
- VRV / VRF / Multi-V systems
- High-wall splits, cassettes, ducted, rooftop and floor-standing units

## Brands installed and serviced

Jet-Air, LG, Daikin, Samsung, Hisense, Midea, York, Alliance, DB

## Notable clients

SARS, Gautrain, Broll, Builders Warehouse, Hyundai, Land Rover, University of Johannesburg, Checkers, Planet Fitness

## Sectors served

- Commercial: shopping centres, server rooms, office developments, hotels, healthcare, educational institutions
- Industrial: mining, transportation hubs, food supply chain, government infrastructure, factories, warehouses
- Residential: single residences, estates, complexes, social developments, gyms and recreational nodes
